name: Evolution, Ecology, and Organismal Biology PhD
detailsNote: Program confirms January 10,2027 for Fall admission/fellowships; central annual funding dateJanuary 5 differs. Admission model not directly stated.

english.note: IELTS Academic no component below 6. Tests within two years before enrollment; unofficial for review, official after admission. Home Edition/IELTS Online accepted; no ITP+, MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Degree where English is exclusive instruction can exempt; foreign institution checked in WHED and extra proof may be required. TA requirements separate.

applicationFee.note: Central table explicitly covers Summer 2024–Spring 2027: international 155 USD/domestic 135; Fall 2027 fee not yet confirmed. Financial-hardship/preparation waivers limited to eligible US citizens/permanent residents/undocumented applicants, approved before payment, request at least 5 businessdays early.

documents: Unofficial transcripts from all colleges/universities for review; official records after acceptance
Graduate statement of purpose, maximum 2000 words: preparation, interests, UCR fit, motivation, goals/impact and community contribution
Three recommendation letters in English (two academic)
Foreign degrees: WES course-by-course ICAP evaluation after accepting offer; degree proof and certified English translations
requirements.note: Biology/related bachelor’s; other science backgrounds accepted with biology, organic/inorganic chemistry, physics and calculus preparation. Contact faculty early; admission unlikely without identified prospective advisor/prior communication. Three letters at least one professor, direct-knowledge mentors preferred. Conditional international financial statement. Admission model not directly established.

funding.note: Most students receive fellowship/TA/RA, automatic consideration, no guarantee. TA/GSR at 25% or more gives partial fees/health coverage; international GSR at 45% or more may receive nonresident tuition remission. Other uncovered costs depend on offer.
